title: Per-harness memory adapter role
description: Declares the memory-topology role of one harness against the canonical memory layer (write-canonical-entry.js + the ledger). Exactly one declared role per harness. See _dev/concepts/topological-sovereignty-memory/concept.md and tools/memory/README.md.

role.description: source = the one canonical store of truth (only ONE harness may be source). cache+native-hint = a local cache the harness reads natively, receipt-bound to canonical (no cache write without a canonical receipt). explicit-read+hook-emulated = no native pocket; reads canonical explicitly and emulates write/recall via hooks. unavailable = no memory surface yet; declares incapability honestly rather than claiming an unverified capability.

cache_path.description: For cache roles: the local pocket path (informational). Null for source/unavailable.

receipt_bound.description: True if this adapter blocks cache writes until canonical returns a receipt. MUST be true for any cache role (the load-bearing invariant). N/A (false) for unavailable.

next_step.description: REQUIRED when role=unavailable: the named work that would close the gap (so 'unavailable' carries a path forward, not a dead end). Null otherwise.
